name: Model-based Coordinate System (M-rep)
definition: A coordinate system (u, v, τ) derived from M-reps (medial representations) to provide guidance for solid texture synthesis. u and v parameterize the medial sheet (skeletal surface midway between opposing boundaries), and τ is the fraction of the spoke from the medial sheet to the boundary. This provides correspondence between different instances of anatomical models.
summary: The Model-based Coordinate System parameterizes volumetric data using a medial sheet and spokes to establish semantic correspondence between anatomical instances, distinguishing itself by encoding intrinsic topology rather than surface projection.
